task_description: Construct task-specific GO augmentation for predicting transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations, using one shared knowledge overlay across the complete supplied gene universe.
knowledge_requirements: Integrate all biological database records that match the complete gene universe and satisfy the planned source, evidence, and mapping policies.
Acquire literature-derived functional and mechanistic evidence using task-wide topic queries and shared paper bundles.
Link supported gene functions to existing GO concepts, retain genuinely additional concepts and typed mechanisms, and preserve biological conditions.

retrieval_budget.record_budget_scope: max_candidate_records applies exclusively to literature_extracted candidate statements. Process selected database sources to completion and retain all eligible gene-universe mappings. Database record counts follow source content and declared evidence filters; review sample sizes govern audit inspection only.
